s1.syndrome_frame: Asymptomatic eruptive facial lesion in a patient with hematologic malignancy
salient_findings: Diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens
key_facts: 63-year-old man
Asymptomatic facial lesion
Lesion located under the right lower eyelid
Lesion size: 3×2–mm
Lesion shape: smooth, red, dome-shaped papule
History of chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome
History of refractory anemia with excess blasts
Skin biopsy showed atypical dermal infiltrate
Cells in infiltrate were positive for CD207/langerin
Cells in infiltrate were negative for myeloperoxidase
BRAF-V600E variant identified through immunohistochemical studies
Prior bone marrow biopsy showed hypercellular bone marrow
Prior bone marrow biopsy showed atypical erythropoiesis
Myeloblasts present in bone marrow (10% to 15%)
Identical pathogenic variations in ASXL1, IDH2, and STAG2 genes in bone marrow and skin biopsy specimens

per_call: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with Minimal Differentiation

shortlist.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed atypical dermal infiltrate positive for CD207/langerin

shortlist.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed atypical dermal infiltrate and patient has history of myelodysplastic syndrome

shortlist.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts

shortlist.label: Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts

shortlist.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with Maturation
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of myelodysplastic syndrome and refractory anemia with excess blasts

raw.rationale: The presence of a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells positive for CD207/langerin and negative for myeloperoxidase, along with the identification of the BRAF-V600E variant, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
rejected.why: While this condition can present with skin lesions, the specific immunohistochemical profile (positive for CD207/langerin) and the presence of the BRAF-V600E variant are more characteristic of Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis.

rejected.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
rejected.why: Myeloid sarcoma would typically show positivity for myeloperoxidase, which is not seen in this case.

rejected.label: Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia
rejected.why: This diagnosis does not typically present with isolated skin lesions or the specific immunophenotypic features seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with Maturation
rejected.why: The presence of a specific skin lesion with a unique immunohistochemical profile (CD207/langerin positive) and the absence of myeloperoxidase positivity do not align with Acute Myeloid Leukemia with Maturation.
